domain_description: Policy enforcement, compliance auditing, quality gate management, and access control for enterprise AI systems. Covers regulatory compliance tracking, automated audit generation, role-based access control, and quality assurance across the engine build pipeline aligned with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOX, and COBIT frameworks.
authority_sources: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 (Security and Privacy Controls)

engines.name: Policy Enforcement Engine
engines.function: Define, deploy, and enforce organizational policies across AI systems, code repositories, and operational processes using policy-as-code, automated compliance checking, and violation alerting.
doctrine_topics: policy lifecycle management (draft, review, approve, enforce, retire)
automated policy violation detection and alerting
real-time policy evaluation at decision points
regulatory mapping to internal policy controls

golden_queries.question: Design a policy enforcement system that prevents deployment of any engine code that contains hardcoded credentials, lacks type hints, or has fewer than 3 test cases, with exception workflows for emergency deployments

engines.name: Compliance Audit Engine
engines.function: Conduct automated compliance audits against regulatory frameworks (SOX, GDPR, ISO 27001), generate audit reports, track findings, and manage remediation workflows.
doctrine_topics: automated audit evidence collection and preservation
audit finding classification and risk scoring
continuous compliance monitoring vs periodic audit
audit report generation and executive summarization
cross-framework compliance mapping (NIST to ISO to SOX)
third-party and supply chain compliance assessment

golden_queries.question: Generate an automated compliance audit report for an AI system processing personal data across US and EU jurisdictions, mapping controls to both SOX 404 and GDPR requirements
How should continuous compliance monitoring differ from annual SOX audits, and what automated controls can reduce audit burden by 60%?

engines.name: Quality Gate Management Engine
engines.function: Define, evaluate, and enforce quality gates across the engine build pipeline including code quality, test coverage, documentation completeness, security scanning, and performance benchmarks.
doctrine_topics: quality gate definition and threshold configuration
multi-dimensional quality scoring (code, test, docs, security, perf)
gate pass/fail criteria and scoring rubrics
quality trend tracking and regression detection

golden_queries.question: Design a 9-gate quality system for the TIE engine build pipeline where each engine must pass code quality, test coverage, documentation, security scan, performance benchmark, doctrine coverage, API consistency, error handling, and deployment readiness checks

engines.name: Access Control Engine
engines.function: Manage role-based and attribute-based access control across AI systems, API endpoints, data stores, and administrative functions with audit logging, privilege escalation detection, and zero-trust verification.
doctrine_topics: role-based access control (RBAC) design and implementation
API endpoint authorization and rate limiting
service account and machine identity management
access audit logging and anomaly detection

golden_queries.question: Design an access control system for a fleet of 400+ AI engines where different user roles (Commander, Operator, Viewer, API Consumer) have different permissions across query, configuration, deployment, and administrative functions
